claim_boundary: Exact binary-quartic/projective-root calculation using Nurowski's displayed Section-4 equations. It proves blockwise torsor structures. It does not yet identify the nonabelian order-16 cross kernel up to SmallGroup type or prove a single order-16 group acts globally and simultaneously on all eleven blocks.

cross_fibres.torsor_statement: each B_{k,c} is a coset torsor for the order-16 kernel of chi; D_a transports the Phi_0 statement to all k

external_equations.cross_rule: H2|L = c(L) H1|L with c(L)^3=1 and 16 lines for each c

theorem: The eleven 16-line Schur-176 blocks are not a uniform C2^4 bundle. The two common cores H,K carry regular V4xV4=C2^4 product torsors. The nine cross blocks are 16-element cosets of the Hessian character kernel in the 48-element exact binary-quartic graph-line symmetry; that kernel contains the order-four scalar iI, so it is not C2^4.
